ORCH_ENABLE_AUTOPRESS.note: must be 1, otherwise the script prints that it is off and exits

ORCH_TOOL_DIR.note: the BUNDLE ROOT (the folder holding functions/, roles/, bin/, lib/; installed copy: <ORCH_HOME>/app). Only this form is accepted. Used only for the Monitor run shape (<root>/functions/watch/hc-watch.mjs) and the pending.ps1 command form; files inside it are never auto-approved for editing. Unset or any other folder = Monitor/pending forms stay manual

ORCH_DOCS_DIR.note: the ONLY folder where file edits may be auto-approved (documents). Default is used only if the folder exists; unset+missing = off. Must not contain/sit inside/equal ORCH_TOOL_DIR or the config folder (start refused)

autopress-allow.txt.note: config\ file: extra allowed command forms, one anchored regex (^...$) per line, # comments; only adds to the built-in list

ORCH_PROXY_TARGET.note: regex of the target window name

ORCH_PROXY_TITLE.note: regex of the target's border title
